audit_items.proof_trace: All three preconditions are enforced: (1) `whenRaiseHasEnded` modifier calls `_verifyCapitalRaiseHasEnded()` (L637-639) which reverts if `s_capitalRaiseStatus.hasEnded == false`; (2) `whenRefundPeriodIsOver` modifier calls `_verifyRefundPeriodIsOver()` (L659-664) which reverts if `block.timestamp < refundEndTime` — the `refundEndTime == 0` edge case is unreachable because `end()` always sets it and `whenRaiseHasEnded` blocks execution if `end()` was never called; (3) `_verifyCanWithdrawCapital()` (L649-656) called in the function body before any transfer reverts if `totalCapitalRaised == 0`, requiring a prior successful `publishRaisedCapital()` call with a non-zero amount.
